title: Two repo-level status blocks hardcode stale package/spec versions (apps/console/README.md, QUICK_REFERENCE.md) — same drift shape as #4125, different site
body:
Out-of-scope finding from #4125 (the two `**Version:**` lines under `content/docs/`).

#4125's sweep claim — "the only two `**Version:**` lines under `content/docs/`" — is **correct and still holds**. But the same grep run repo-wide finds two more hand-written version blocks outside `content/docs/`, drifted by the same construction and by comparable margins.

## Fact (verified on `origin/main` = `148ade326`)

| Site | Claim | Reality |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/console/README.md:5` | `**Version:** 0.5.1` | `apps/console/package.json` = `17.4.0` |
| `apps/console/README.md:5` | `**Spec:** @objectstack/spec v3.0.7` | resolved `@objectstack/spec` = `17.0.0-rc.5` |
| `QUICK_REFERENCE.md:107` | `**Version:** v3.3.2 (latest published patch…)` | packages ship `17.4.0` |
| `QUICK_REFERENCE.md:108` | `**Spec:** @objectstack/spec ^4.0.4` | manifests declare `^17.0.0-rc.5` |
| `QUICK_REFERENCE.md:109` | `**Client:** @objectstack/client ^4.0.4` | manifests declare `^17.0.0-rc.5` |

`QUICK_REFERENCE.md`'s block is titled **"Current Release"**, so every line under it is a claim about the present state; the `^4.0.4` entries even carry a parenthetical rationale ("upgraded from 3.3.x") that describes a migration two majors behind the tree.

## Why this is a separate card, not part of #4125

Same defect class, different site — exactly the #4125 / #4130 split, where the docs page and the package README each needed their own card because the first fix's scope did not reach the second file. #4125's fix (PR for that card) is scoped to `content/docs/` and the direction taken there was *remove the line*, which suits an incidental one-liner beside a package name.

Neither of these is an incidental one-liner, so the direction is not automatic and should not be inherited blindly:

- `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`'s "Current Release" section is a **deliberately maintained status block** that also names Node, pnpm and React ranges (those three are currently accurate). Removing the version lines guts the section's purpose; regenerating or trimming it to the non-drifting entries are both real options.
- `apps/console/README.md:5` is a one-line badge row combining version, spec version and a roadmap link.

## Why observation-class

Nothing consumes either file programmatically, and neither drives an install command — a reader is misinformed about which release they are looking at, but no copy-pasteable instruction is wrong. Grading is the triage round's call.

## Searched for duplicates

`QUICK_REFERENCE version stale`, `console README version spec drift`, and `hardcoded version` over open issues in this repo: only #4125 itself, which is the `content/docs/` site and does not cover these two files.
